c3_draft_rules: 4h closed bars only. Signal bar `b`.
EMA20 and EMA50 of close; ATR14 (Wilder).
All values at or before `b` are causal. The earliest `b` is 220, the shared runner warm-up, with every referenced indicator finite and ATR > 0.
(shorts are the exact mirror: swap high/low, invert every comparison and reference side).
Trend already established before the pullback, measured at `b−1`:
EMA50 slope: EMA50[b−1] − EMA50[b−7] ≥ 0.5·ATR[b−1];
C > EMA50 on at least 10 of the 12 bars b−12..b−1.
Swing reference: H = max(high[b−12..b−1]), and `h_idx` is its bar. On a tie, the latest bar wins.
Pullback over bars `h_idx+1..b−1`, at least 2 bars:
Depth: H − min(low) ≥ 1.0·ATR[b−1].
It reaches the trend reference: some bar has low ≤ EMA20[that bar] + 0.25·ATR[b−1].
Structure holds: no close < EMA50 on those bars, and min(low) ≥ EMA50[b−1] − 0.5·ATR[b−1].
L = min(low[h_idx+1..b]), including the trigger bar.
Resumption trigger at the close of `b`:
C[b] > high[b−1] (strict);
C[b] > EMA20[b];
body C−O ≥ 0.3·ATR[b−1];
close location (C−low)/(high−low) ≥ 0.60, failing if high = low;
C[b] < H (the trigger must come before the breakout, which keeps this distinct from C2).
Entry at open[b+1].
Stop = L − 0.2·ATR[b]. Skip the signal if entry ≤ stop.
R = entry − stop. Quality guard: skip if R > 3.0·ATR[b].
Cost guard: skip unless R / entry ≥ 1.0%. Fees of 2×5 bps plus slippage of 2×2 bps cost at most 0.14 R before funding.
Target: 2.5R from the actual entry.
Invalidation: C < EMA50 at the close of any bar from b+1 on, exiting at the next open. Equality does not invalidate.
Time cap: decided at the close of b+30, exit at open b+31 (5 days).
Exit priority: as C2. A gap through the stop or target at the open owns the label. Otherwise the intrabar stop beats the target, and invalidation beats the time cap.
One position per symbol, both sides combined.
A signal at close x−1 is ignored if the open trade exits at open x.
Setup consumption: after a signal (taken or skipped), the next signal on that symbol needs a new swing high. Concretely, `h_idx′ > b`. Blocked signals do not extend the setup.
Funding is charged on the closes of bars e..x inclusive, always as a cost.
Any missing, gapped or invalid bar refuses the whole tier, as in the C1/C2 runner. Bars are never filled.

frozen_c3_lifecycle: Long swing high is the latest tied max high in b−12..b−1. Pullback bars are h_idx+1..b−1 and must contain at least two bars. L includes the trigger bar b. Short is the exact low-side mirror.

A qualifying signal consumes its setup whether taken, no-next-bar, gap-skipped, cost/quality-skipped, or overlap-ignored. A candidate failing a signal gate does not consume. A candidate blocked by prior consumption does not extend it.
Next long setup requires a new swing-high index > prior signal b; next short setup requires a new swing-low index > prior signal b. Consumption is per symbol across both sides.
One slot per symbol. A signal at close x−1 is ignored/consumed when the existing trade exits at open x. An open_end trade owns the slot forever within that dataset.
Entry is actual open b+1. Entry ≤ stop (long) / entry ≥ stop (short) skips. R cap equality and cost-guard equality pass.

At each later open: protective gap stop/target owns fill and label; otherwise a scheduled invalidation/time exit fills. Then intrabar stop beats target. Close-based invalidation/time schedules next-open; invalidation beats time on same close.
Same-bar long/short candidate conflict is unreachable under valid trend filters; assert it and test by injection only.
Costs/funding use the accepted C2 parity convention.
frozen_c3_parameters: 4h; EMA20/EMA50; slope ≥0.5·ATR over b−7→b−1; trend persistence at least 10/12; pullback depth ≥1.0·ATR; EMA20 touch zone +0.25·ATR; stop buffer 0.2·ATR[b]; R cap ≤3.0·ATR[b]; cost guard R/actual entry ≥1.0%; target 2.5R; time decision b+30 / exit open b+31.
All comparisons/equalities remain exactly as drafted. Ordinary existing EMA/ATR implementation; 220 real warm-up bars; every referenced value finite and ATR >0.

prereg.rule_text:
C3 `trend_pullback_continuation.v0`: research-only signal detector + per-symbol simulator (synthetic fixtures first).

Frozen contract (later overrides earlier): Build draft #13 6230936151, Cowork fixture plan 6230959827, Codex FREEZE
6230952961 (authoritative; where Cowork differs, Codex wins: an overlap-ignored signal DOES consume its setup).
DEVELOPMENT ONLY: this module reads no cache, store, archive or holdout and is registered nowhere (not
strategies.STRATEGIES, not engine slots / sleeves / presets, not the app). It runs on an in-memory frame (columns o, h, l,
c; optional v / t; optional `e20` / `e50` / `atr` to inject the indicators in fixtures).

Indicators (the existing strategies implementation, pinned):
  EMA20 / EMA50 = strategies.ema(close, n) = pandas ewm(span=n, adjust=False): alpha = 2/(n+1), recursive,
    seeded with EMA[0] = close[0] (no SMA seed, no bias adjustment).
  ATR14 = strategies.indicators()['atr']: TR = max(H-L, |H-C[-1]|, |L-C[-1]|) (TR[0] = H[0]-L[0]), Wilder ewm
    alpha 1/14, adjust=False, seeded with TR[0].
  The 220-bar warm-up makes both seeds immaterial in practice; the rule is stated so a re-implementation matches.
Cost constants are imported from backtest (FEE taker 5 bps per fill, SLIP 2 bps per fill, FUND_PER_BAR 5e-5 per 4h
bar on the real closes of bars e..x inclusive, always a cost) - the accepted C2 parity convention.

Rules (long; short is the exact price mirror, implemented by running the long code on (-o, -l, -h, -c) with
-EMA20 / -EMA50; ATR is mirror-invariant). Signal bar b, 4h closed bars.
  eligibility: b >= 220; EMA20[b-11..b], EMA50[b-12..b-1] finite (every EMA a gate reads); ATR14[b-1], ATR14[b] finite and > 0.
  trend (at b-1): EMA20[b-1] > EMA50[b-1]; EMA50[b-1] - EMA50[b-7] >= 0.5 ATR[b-1];
    C[j] > EMA50[j] (per bar, strict) on at least 10 of j = b-12..b-1.
  swing: H = max(high[b-12..b-1]); h_idx = the LATEST bar holding that max (ties -> latest).
  pullback bars P = h_idx+1..b-1, len(P) >= 2:
    depth  H - min(low[P]) >= 1.0 ATR[b-1];
    touch  some j in P: low[j] <= EMA20[j] + 0.25 ATR[b-1]  (per-bar EMA, single ATR at b-1);
    structure  no j in P with C[j] < EMA50[j] (per bar; equality holds) and min(low[P]) >= EMA50[b-1] - 0.5 ATR[b-1].
    The trigger bar's low is deliberately not checked against the floor (the R cap bites instead).
  trigger at close b: C[b] > high[b-1] (strict); C[b] > EMA20[b]; C[b] - O[b] >= 0.3 ATR[b-1];
    H[b] > L[b] and C[b] - L[b] >= 0.60 (H[b] - L[b]); C[b] < H (strict: before the breakout, distinct from C2).
  L = min(low[h_idx+1..b]) (includes the trigger bar).  stop = L - 0.2 ATR[b].
  entry = open[b+1] = E.  Skips: E <= stop (gap_stop); R = E - stop > 3.0 ATR[b] (quality; equality passes);
    R < 1.0% x E (real price) (cost_guard; equality passes).  target = E + 2.5R (rebased from the actual entry).
  exits (bar k >= b+1): at open[k], a gap through stop (O <= stop) or target (O >= target) fills at the open and owns
    the label, even over a pending close-rule exit; else a pending close-rule exit fills at open[k]; else intrabar stop
    (L <= stop) beats target (H >= target), both at their level; then at close[k]: C[k] < EMA50[k] -> invalidation
    (equality does not invalidate), k == b+30 -> time; invalidation label wins; fills at open[k+1] (time: open b+31).
  setup consumption (symbol level, both sides): a candidate that passes every gate is a signal iff its swing index
    h_idx > the previous signal's b (long: swing-high index, short: swing-low index); every signal consumes (taken,
    no-next-bar, gap-skipped, quality/cost-skipped, overlap-ignored); a blocked candidate or a failed gate consumes
    nothing (a blocked candidate does not move the marker).
  one trade per symbol: a signal at b is taken only when no trade is open at the close of b (a trade whose exit fills at
    open[b+1] still owns the slot; an open_end trade owns it for the rest of the dataset); otherwise it is ignored.
  same-b long/short conflict is unreachable (EMA20[b-1] > EMA50[b-1] and < at once); it is asserted, not handled.
Every threshold comparison is exact (fractions of the float inputs and of the decimal constants), so equality fixtures
follow the written operators exactly.
